== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The original targets an opponent’s smuggler at the same site. The later version specifies a smuggler present with Greedo and omits the opponent qualification. Both keep the remainder-of-turn cancellation and the singular control-phase search for Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?. The question mark is part of the Interrupt title.
